mission: Build AI features for enterprise HR and support systems that already have real users and messy data.
responsibilities: Built RAG systems with LangChain and LangGraph, including permission-aware retrieval over ServiceNow knowledge with citations.
Built agentic workflows with tool calling, integrated with SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow REST APIs.
Built an HR support system that classifies emails, creates ServiceNow tickets, and drafts replies for human review.
Designed a recruitment ranking platform combining semantic matching with deterministic scoring (FastAPI, Chroma/FAISS, local LLMs).
Built a Simulated Annealing workforce scheduler that cut planning from about 3 hours to about 50 seconds.
Used LangSmith for tracing and evaluation, Azure AI services for backend work, and prototyped features with the Gemini API.
growth: I now judge AI work by whether it can be evaluated and rolled back, not by how well it demos.
lessons: Most problems show up in the integrations (APIs, documents, tickets), not in the model.
If I can't explain a score or a draft to the person reviewing it, it isn't ready to ship.

mission: Build and maintain production mobile apps for enterprise clients.
responsibilities: Designed modular app architectures and optimized performance-critical screens.
Owned shared libraries used across multiple apps.
Ran CI/CD pipelines and releases, and handled backend integration.
Published redacted, an open-source Flutter package for loading skeletons, on pub.dev.
growth: I learned to choose designs that are easy to run and debug over ones that are clever. That still guides how I build AI systems.
lessons: The weeks after a release show how good the architecture really is.
Frameworks change, but good release habits carry over.
